title: myosotis palustris var. repens
intro: Myosotis palustris var. repens, commonly known as creeping forget-me-not, is a low-growing, spreading plant that belongs to the borage family and is native to Europe and Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antiseptic. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to be derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Myosotis palustris var. repens for medicinal purposes.
